simple.meaning: מִסְפּוֹא (miçpôwʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “fodder.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 24:25. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִסְפּוֹא (H4554) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מִסְפּוֹא (miçpôwʼ) / H4554 is traced through Genesis 24:25, Genesis 24:32, Genesis 42:27, Genesis 43:24 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

timeline.evidenceText: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”
